verdict.rationale: Infrastructure instrumentation is a fair axis for a monitoring product, but the evidence shows no Sentry-maintained host, container, Kubernetes, or cloud-service agents. Sentry instead says "No agents to install" and relies on in-app SDKs. OTLP ingestion through a third-party OpenTelemetry Collector and a Cloudflare Workers error-forwarding integration are adjacent, app-level paths, not vendor-maintained infrastructure agents.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can instrument hosts, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud services through vendor-maintained agents and integrations
